verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's Gateway documents several programmatic surfaces: an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, an HTTP endpoint for invoking a single tool directly, HTTP hooks that let external services submit agent turns, and an A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC binding with authenticated task submission. Together these let a user drive the product through documented APIs. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec (the probe found all OpenAPI paths 404), evidence that the API covers more than a 'small' chat-completions surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Expose an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions HTTP endpoint from the Gateway
OpenClaw's Gateway exposes an HTTP endpoint for invoking a single tool directly.
Gateway HTTP hooks let an external service wake an agent or submit an agent turn.
External agents discover the gateway through a public Agent Card and submit authenticated text tasks using the A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC binding.
